protocol.planner: actual next-step collision filter, then shortest static next-head path to current food; next body except head is blocked
protocol.model_input: current physical state, action question, candidate descriptions only
protocol.sample_rng: independent Python Random per episode, SHA256([episode_id, seed]) first 32 bits; one recorded draw per model decision
protocol.attribution: food collection and survival use a common code planner; models choose only residual ties

model.chooser: uniform over common-planner candidates; no learned or optimal tie preference

selection: all Snake episodes in requested splits, original order
